title: Stranger with Air Force ties at Hart Canyon

tellings.quote: A stranger with curious ties to the Air Force. He showed up at Hart Canyon, which is very obscure and hard to get to at the same time we did.

plain: In 2026 a stranger with what Michels calls "curious ties to the Air Force" turned up at Hart Canyon, near Aztec, New Mexico, at the very moment Michels and his crew arrived. Hart Canyon is the remote spot his episode links to a claimed crash that left sixteen alien bodies. Michels tells this himself, from his own trip, and stresses that the place is "very obscure and hard to get to," so the timing would suggest someone was keeping an eye on the site.
